rule.statement: The effect of Sections 10(2) and 10(5) of the Rent Act No. 1972 is that unauthorised sub-letting of premises falling within the purview of the Act, by the tenant to a third party, confers on the landlord or landlady as the case may be, the right to a decree for ejectment of the tenant and sub-tenant.
